newsitem.title: DUBAI: Ekeus meets Qatari minister on Gulf tour.
newsitem.headline: Ekeus meets Qatari minister on Gulf tour.

text.p: The United Nations official in charge of destroying Iraq's mass destruction weapons held talks with Qatar's minister of state for foreign affairs on Saturday.
The official Qatar News Agency said Rolf Ekeus briefed Ahmad Abdullah al-Mahmood on his mission's work.
Ekeus is on a Gulf tour seeking financial suppport for his commission set up after the 1991 Gulf War to end Iraq's mass destruction capability.
He had earlier visited Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
The UAE-based Gulf Today on Thursday quoted Ekeus as saying he had received assurances from Saudi Arabia and Kuwait that any shortfall in commission funds would be covered.
